nom: Pixi Glow Tonic 5% Glycolic Acid Exfoliating Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner balances oil production and makes pores look less noticeable, describing skin as more balanced and less 'fat'.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin say it leaves skin hydrated, soft, and not stripped, though one is unsure yet whether it truly suits very dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as a middle ground that controls T-zone oil without over-drying the rest of the face, working well every other day.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as sensitive report no irritation and calm, soft skin, including one case of mild rosacea handled gently, though one non-sensitive reviewer warns sensitive users to patch-test first.
segments.mature: One reviewer close to fifty describes visibly smoother, dewy, baby-soft skin after just two days of sample use.

concerns.aging: A reviewer nearing fifty reports smoother, dewy, clearer-looking skin; others mention brighter, more youthful appearance with regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the toner leaves skin hydrated, soft, and plump rather than dry, including one who says it counters dryness from cold weather; a few describe it as 'a little thick' on application.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with mild rosacea reports the product feels calm and gentle rather than irritating on her skin afterward.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as non-stripping and non-irritating, with skin feeling clean but not tight or damaged, and no burning reported even with daily use.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots, sun spots, and acne scars, plus more even skin tone; one specifically credits it with removing marks left by picked pimples.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and reduced tiny pimples with continued use; no reviewer reports new breakouts or worsened acne.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the toner helps control excess oil and minimizes the look of pores without over-drying skin.

extraits.texte: I'd heard several folks swear by the Glow Tonic and was curious about it. I have combination skin I'd tried some AHA toners and found them too harsh for my skin-- partially because many contain salicylic acid, which irritates it and dries it out. This is a great middle ground: the glycolic acid exfoliates to keep my skin from getting dull from dry skin cells and it keeps the oil in my T-zone under control while also not being so harsh as to dry the rest of my face out. A+ will definitely be buying again.

extraits.titre: Wonderful part of the Glow family
extraits.texte: I received this in my last order as a gift, and I absolutely love it and will be adding it to my routine! It leaves my skin feeling clean but not stripped. My skin looks and feels calm afterwards - I have mild rosacea and I love that Pixi products are effective but gentle. Love this!
Very surprised by the refreshing feeling of this tonic. No need for the fridge with this one. I have very dry skin so I am not sure if this one is for me or not, but doggone it.....I'm in love!
Love this tonic because with it my skin is more balanced and not so much fat and pores have become less noticeable

extraits.titre: I wish I'd discovered a long time ago
extraits.texte: I wish I'd discovered this product a long time ago. My face feels like a baby's bum and I'm almost fifty. After two days of using a sample I'm hooked. I've almost bought the entire line now. 11 hours after toning my skin this morning and wearing no foundation my skin looks dewy and clear. I can't wait to see how long term usage increases not only the flow but clarity of my skin. Thank you.

I've been using this toner for a few years now, and I don't go a day without it. When I first started using it, I would put it on in the morning and at night. Once my acne started clearing up, I started using it only before bed, before moisturizer. It feels so good going on and does wonders for acne.

I usually use the Glycolic lAcid liquid toner, but decided to try the pads, because of their convenience to travel with. I use to love the Bliss Glycolic Acid pads in a blue box that were individually wrapped, but they aren't available in stores anymore. These pads are too thin and not very saturated with moisture, but thet have a good textured exfoliating side. I end up using 2 exfoliating pads, because they are so thin. They have not caused any skin irritation on my face or neck, but I prefer to using the Pixi liquid glycolic acid toner in the bottle.
